art_canvas.crop_rules: Keep tails, antennae, dust and moving roaches within each fixed cell; keep ground registration stable. Dimensions are art targets, not final collision boxes.

layering.required: Animate roach churn in every formed idle, movement, telegraph and recovery loop; a stationary form must never become a static silhouette.
layering.base: Readable rat/alligator body mass with baked moving roaches; existing game pixel-art style.
layering.overlays: Separate transparent authored roach-motion overlays and optional per-form masks for phase-offset playback.

individual_roaches.animation: 4–6 frames per authored facing; floor crawl and turn readability.

layering.shadow: Separate ground layer; no baked opaque environment.
layering.runtime_note: Cosmetic roaches reuse Art sprites and do not become dozens of physics/HP actors. Aggregate floor-phase collision is a proposal for Mechanics, not final behavior.

animation_targets.formed_loops: 8–12 frames with seamless churn; 10–12fps starting playback proposal
animation_targets.transitions: 12–16 frame one-shot targets with coherent start/end registration; durations are stretchable pending Mechanics
animation_targets.attacks: Reserve windup/attack/recovery states for both forms; choreography and damaging frames pending Mechanics, not invented by Engineering.
animation_targets.facing: Both travel/facing directions supported by explicit art or documented safe mirroring

safety_contract: Collision bounds derive from validated visible form bodies, not the full transparent cell or every moving antenna.
Retain readable attack warnings and distinct harmless collapse/reform timing until Mechanics defines damaging phases.
One encounter lifecycle owns phase transitions, pause, damage threshold, death and reset; do not accidentally replay terminal death on collapse.
Checkpoint retry must reset phase, threshold latch, cosmetic roaches, sounds and warnings deterministically.
Do not introduce a mandatory kill gate, encounter location or arena geometry without the approved level contract.
